title: Saturday: a promise for today rolls to Monday
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. Date of birth 14 March 1988, last four digits 4471. Says he can pay the full amount today. Accepts the next business day when told today is not a business day. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent does not record a promise for Saturday 17 October
the agent offers Monday 19 October, the next business day
